hypotheses.P1_full_scale_robustness: For all three rankings at rank 4, aggregate scale-1 causal fidelity changes by no more than 0.10 when the same checkpoint weights are evaluated in float32 rather than bfloat16.
hypotheses.P2_local_quadratic_scaling: Across validation sites, the median coefficient of variation of Fisher target-effect energy divided by scale squared is at most 0.20 over scales 0.01 through 0.10.
hypotheses.P3_local_fidelity_limit: For magnitude rank 1, the median absolute category-level fidelity difference between scales 0.01 and 0.02 is at most 0.10.
hypotheses.P4_reordered_rank4_survives: In float32 at scale 1, both value-greedy and Fisher-greedy rank 4 retain median fidelity at least 0.30 and beat their complements in at least two of three categories.
